description: CLI-first release preparation: align onboarding and fresh image defaults, remove automatic legacy npm co-release coupling, verify exact-source documentation, and test packaged installation and saved-state recreation. Core and agro-web implementation use separate sandbox worktrees under one advisor. Docker installation and recreation run only on disposable existing CI runners, not this sandbox or the operator host. Preserve operator state and retained compatibility behavior. Typecheck means the affected repository checks listed in the PRD; scope and final acceptance entries use core CLI and agro-web checks against accepted heads. Source PRD US-011 is split into JSON US-011 (recreation tests) and US-012 (CI verification); source PRD US-012 becomes JSON US-013. This conversion does not authorize execution, live migration, or publication.
